lines.beaver_en: Minsu, are you okay? Your face is red.
lines.en: No, it's hard because it's so hot.

lines.beaver: 이마에 땀이 많이 나요. 좀 쉬어요.
lines.beaver_en: You're sweating a lot on your forehead. Take a rest.
lines.beaver_roman: imae ttami mani nayo. jom swieoyo.
lines.en: Yes, my back is sweating a lot too.

lines.beaver_en: Let's go to the bench under that tree.
lines.en: The soles of my feet hurt because we walked a lot.

lines.beaver: 신발 벗고 발을 좀 움직여 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Take off your shoes and move your feet a bit.
lines.beaver_roman: sinbal beotgo bareul jom umjigyeo bwayo.
lines.en: My toes hurt too. It's because my shoes are small.

lines.beaver_en: Drink some water. I'll give you mine.
lines.en: Thanks. My lips are so dry.

lines.beaver_en: Is everything else okay? How about your head?
lines.learner: 머리는 괜찮아요. 그런데 가슴이 좀 답답해요.
lines.en: My head is fine. But my chest feels a bit tight.
lines.roman: meorineun gwaenchanayo. geureonde gaseumi jom dapdapaeyo.

lines.beaver: 오늘 너무 덥기 때문에 그래요. 천천히 쉬어요.
lines.beaver_en: It's because it's so hot today. Rest slowly.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul neomu deopgi ttaemune geuraeyo. cheoncheonhi swieoyo.
lines.en: Okay, can I put my legs up on the bench?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. It's even more comfortable with your legs up.
lines.learner: 정말 좋아요. 이제 땀이 좀 덜 나요.
lines.en: This is great. I'm sweating a little less now.
lines.roman: jeongmal joayo. ije ttami jom deol nayo.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we rest a bit and go to a cool café?
lines.en: Sounds good. Cafés are comfortable because they're cool.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's get up. I'll carry your bag.
lines.en: Thanks. My back and chest are fine now.
